summary: Report incomplete storage scan measurements safely

delivery.outcome: Retain incomplete storage measurement state and errors from measure_tree, du, and analysis exceptions through scan_service threshold checks and same-risk merges without allowing silent cleanups on unknown sizes while keeping complete measurements unchanged.
nonGoals: Changing complete successful measurement behavior or Docker daemon timeout handling.

architecture.decision: Introduce PathMeasurement outcome tracking in ServiceDataScanner so measure_tree errors, non-zero du exits, os.walk permission errors, and analysis exceptions propagate completeness and error metadata through _analyze_service_path, scan_service, and _merge_service_entries and block unsafe cleanup.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching service_scanner.py and test_service_scanner.py.

validation.evidence: Regression tests cover measure_tree errors with nonzero bytes, du nonzero exit with partial output, analysis errors below threshold, merge preservation, and unchanged complete scans.
Full unit test suite and repository governance gate pass.
